theme: A quiet Sunday at sea, with the return coming into view
greeting: Sunday on the water, Dan. The one thing on the calendar already ran this morning, so the day is yours between watches — with the tail end of the trip just starting to ask for a few decisions.

needsAttention.title: Cavtat return-day logistics
needsAttention.detail: The Sept 19 disembark still needs a Komolac to Cavtat transfer, a bag hold before the 3 PM check-in, and a roughly 5:15 AM checkout for the 7:30 flight. All three are far easier to lock from shore than from the boat.

needsAttention.title: St Pete gap, Sept 20 to 22
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA on the 20th from Croatia, but the kids are not picked up until the 22nd. The two nights near St Pete before the Orlando villa are still unbooked (p1, overdue).

needsAttention.title: Rental car, Sept 20 to Oct 5
needsAttention.detail: No longer a hedge. With the Pathfinder being driven down later, the full-size SUV for the TPA landing needs booking outright (p1, overdue).

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Kristal R. applied to the job you posted — worth a look once you are back on solid wifi.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and retail — Dwell, NYT Cooking, WSJ's AI roundup, and a run of fall sales.

recipe.title: Chicken and Chickpea Tagine
recipe.why: Autumn's first cool evenings are made for something slow-simmered and warmly spiced.

acts.line: The 15-minute Sunday review with Mike ran at 9 — the week's board is set.
Open water and nothing scheduled, so the middle of the day is entirely yours.
The Sept 19 disembark is close enough that the Cavtat transfers are worth sorting whenever a signal turns up.
